about: Sling styles of the slung long guns (user request 2026-09-25: 'the musket sling is too high ... have sling styles'). A style moves the stowed gun from the placement in carry_gear.json (the 'high' style) in the bind pose: slide_m slides it along its own axis toward the butt (its barrel stays on the same line behind the left shoulder, so the over-the-shoulder draw still finds it). The stowed copy, its collision capsules and the strap anchors on it all follow. tilt_deg turns it in the plane of the back about the butt (pivot 'butt') or the point where it crosses the left shoulder (pivot 'shoulder'), toward the horizontal (the muzzle lower).
